description:
【High-Performance Ebike for Adventurous Riders】Experience the thrill of off-road riding with this high-performance electric bicycle. Designed for adventurous riders, it is equipped with a powerful 1000W high-speed brushless motor that delivers maximum speeds of up to 40km/h. Whether you're cycling uphill or tackling challenging terrain, this ebike provides continuous and reliable power to ensure an excellent riding experience.
【Safe and Responsive Braking System】Ride with confidence knowing that this e-bike is equipped with a reliable safety system, including front and rear hydraulic brakes with power-off function. Even at high speeds, you can stop quickly and smoothly, thanks to the responsive braking system. The bike also features 2pc larger and thicker 180mm disc rotors, which provide more effective braking power and ensure your safety when going downhill.
【Versatile and Comfortable City Commuter Ebike】Experience the ultimate in versatility and comfort with this fat tire electric bike. Equipped with 26x4.0 inch fat tires, it is suitable for all terrains and roads, whether you're navigating rocky beaches, snow-covered countryside, or climbing steep hills. The high-capacity 48V 17.5Ah removable battery provides a long range of more than 37 miles, allowing you to enjoy a relaxing and comfortable ride for extended periods.
【Multiple Riding Modes for Your Convenience】Experience the ultimate in convenience and flexibility with four different riding modes to choose from. Whether you prefer pure electric mode, pedal assist mode, classic bike mode, or cruise control mode, this e-bike offers a riding experience that suits your preferences. The smart display allows you to monitor your journey in real-time, and the USB charging port located at the bottom of the phone holder on the side enables you to charge your phone on-the-go, so you can easily share your adventures with friends and family.
【Ready for Your Next Adventure】Get ready to hit the road with ease, thanks to the K800 e-bike which comes 90% pre-installed. Simply install a few simple accessories such as pedals, front wheel, handlebars, saddle, and headlights, and you're good to go on your next adventure! We offer professional warranty services for every electric bicycle, so you can enjoy peace of mind knowing that we've got you covered in case of any concerns or issues.
